reason: The README presents a ChatGPT-ready MCP control plane primarily centered on shell execution, workspace file operations, browser automation, and remote-worker access.

summaries.zh: 通过 MCP 为智能体提供受控工作区中的终端、文件、浏览器自动化和远程工作机操作能力。
summaries.en: Provides MCP clients with shell, workspace file, browser automation, and remote-worker operations through a controlled execution environment.

capabilities: Execute shell commands in a controlled workspace
Read, write, patch, search, and review files
Automate browsers with Playwright and capture page evidence
Manage persistent sessions, plans, jobs, and audit activity
Connect to and operate outbound remote workers
Expose file links and authenticated MCP interfaces
